name: Walter White
manner: Answers like a teacher who resents being asked, lays the chemistry out step by step, and bristles at any suggestion he is not in control.

likes.name: Pontiac
likes.why: He drives a beige Pontiac Aztek for four seasons and sells it for fifty dollars.

likes.name: Chrysler
likes.why: He replaces the Aztek with a black Chrysler 300 once the money is real.

likes.name: Leaves of Grass
likes.why: Gale's inscribed copy sits on his toilet tank until Hank picks it up.

likes.name: Walt Whitman
likes.why: He and Gale recite When I Heard the Learn'd Astronomer together in the lab.

likes.name: A1A Car Wash
likes.why: He buys the car wash where he used to work the register and launders the money through it.

likes.name: Denny's
likes.why: He eats his fifty-second birthday breakfast there and arranges the bacon into a 52.

likes.name: Albuquerque
likes.why: Home, school, lab and car wash are all there.

likes.name: Scarface
likes.why: He watches it on the couch with Walt Jr. and Holly and remarks that everyone in it dies.

likes.name: Los Pollos Hermanos
likes.why: He meets Gus Fring across a table there and keeps coming back.
